scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web,desktop -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @snp/server" "npm run dev -w @snp/client" "wait-on tcp:3000 && cross-env ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3000 electron ."
scripts.build: npm run build -w @snp/shared && npm run build -w @snp/client && npm run build -w @snp/server
scripts.test: npm run test -w @snp/shared && npm run test -w @snp/server && npm run test -w @snp/client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @snp/server && npm run lint -w @snp/client
